title: A halted cloud orchestrator lingers ~10 min and the Workflow never sees it end
description: Epic ilz, 2026-10-07: after supervision_halted the in-container orchestrator did not exit for ~10 minutes and no completion signal reached the Workflow, which stayed 'running' (parked on work:signal). PR #256 works around it (rerun supersedes a held run), but the root cause is open: find why the orchestrator process lingers after the halt line and why the Workflow does not end on it; make the Workflow end (or record held) promptly on the halt line even if the process lingers.
acceptance_criteria: a halted cloud run's Workflow leaves running within a minute of the halt line; test reproduces the linger; make gate passes
